items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: Smiley Lewis was playing guitar. ... I was going on a job. Smiley Lewis and myself. The band and Smiley Lewis.

ctx.x: I heard about that. Somebody told him.

I was in Monroe. Wow. He stopped me from speeding and he said I was drunk and I wasn't doing either one. I wasn't drunk and I wasn't speeding and I hit him in my head and I was paralyzed and I was in the hospital and I had to be operated on. I stayed in the hospital. I stayed in the hospital three weeks from that and I was on the I list for about a week, I guess. I had a slim chance of making it. I did. I made it. So this is what happened. Well, this happened in 1963. You were coming from a job. You just went on…

items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] With the, uh, Smyler Lewis and P. Eynakin. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Smiley wrote how he gave him.

ctx.x: Fats did it, too. Fats did it.
With the, uh, Smyler Lewis and P. Eynakin. D&Anakin, Smarter was on it.
Yeah, Smiley wrote how he gave him.
